name: coord
title: Agent coordination
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Durable attributed inboxes, safe-point pull, grants and explicit scope resume.
description: The replaceable coordination-v0 policy over the core protected operational domain. Restart closes inbox admission, never suspends backend processes or replays uncertain input. Turning it off leaves native terminals and recovery available; saved evidence stays in its protected domain.

needs.why: Requires the generic protected, separately persisted operational domain; unavailable cores fail closed.
Requires core-resolved callback principals; undeclared calls never gain coordination rights.

works_with.why: Native agent endpoints supply declared delivery and control operations.
Optional agent UI displays the inbox and scope state.

panels: Coordination count-only wake and status data
